content: sqlite-vec vec0 tables run fine under WAL mode in production systems (llama-stack PR 5428, tencent MemoryCore, engam-lite): canonical pragma order is busy_timeout FIRST then journal_mode=WAL then synchronous=NORMAL, because the WAL switch itself needs a write lock. WAL gives multi-process readers-dont-block-writer on same machine; still only one writer at a time.
